cards.title: The US in Brief: Barack Obama v Donald Trump
cards.preview: Obama and Trump take opposing messages to midterm rallies, with Obama challenging divisive attacks on Democratic candidates in Ohio and Michigan. The issue also examines fabricated polling and tight races in Texas.

cards.title: Sexually transmitted infections are surging in Europe
cards.preview: European health authorities report rising syphilis and gonorrhoea despite incomplete testing data. The newsletter weighs possible causes and argues for more testing and less stigma to help curb transmission.
